Phase I: 00:00-00:03
Camera: The overhead camera captures a still shot of a white paper package in a clear plastic folder with a green zipper, positioned centrally on a light-colored table.

Robotic Arm Appearance: Not visible.

Robotic Arm Actions: No robotic arm actions are observed.

Phase II: 00:03-00:05
Camera: The camera maintains a static, overhead perspective of the table, showing the plastic folder.

Robotic Arm Appearance: A black robotic arm with a two-pronged black gripper end-effector enters the frame from the upper left, casting a distinct shadow on the table.

Robotic Arm Actions: The robotic arm moves diagonally downwards toward the top edge of the plastic folder.

Phase III: 00:05-00:06
Camera: The camera remains static, displaying the plastic folder and the robotic arm entering the scene.

Robotic Arm Appearance: The black robotic arm, equipped with a gripper, has positioned one of its prongs on top of the green zipper of the plastic folder.

Robotic Arm Actions: The robotic arm's gripper gently presses down on the plastic folder's green zipper, flattening it against the paper contents, attempting to seal the package.

Phase IV: 00:06-00:08
Camera: The camera holds a consistent overhead view, showing the robotic arm's interaction with the folder.

Robotic Arm Appearance: The black robotic arm's gripper is seen applying pressure on the green zipper, moving horizontally across the top edge.

Robotic Arm Actions: The arm slides its gripper horizontally from left to right along the length of the green zipper, pressing it closed.

Phase V: 00:08-00:10
Camera: The overhead camera provides a clear, static view as the robotic arm completes its action.

Robotic Arm Appearance: The black robotic arm, with its two-pronged gripper, is seen completing the zipper closing action and beginning to retract.

Robotic Arm Actions: The robotic arm finishes sliding the gripper to the rightmost end of the green zipper, then lifts its gripper and moves upwards and to the right, gradually exiting the frame.

Phase VI: 00:10-00:12
Camera: The overhead camera records the scene, with the plastic folder now fully sealed in the center of the table.

Robotic Arm Appearance: Not visible.

Robotic Arm Actions: The robotic arm has completed its task and has moved out of the camera's view.
